responsibility: This definition module declares the standard dynamic memory allocation interface presented to gm2 programs. It belongs to the runtime storage layer and exports ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, and Available on raw SYSTEM.ADDRESS values, defining the stable public heap-management API while leaving the actual policy to the lower-level SysStorage implementation.
same_name_distinction: Public interface half of the Storage pair: it declares the standard ALLOCATE/DEALLOCATE/REALLOCATE/Available API on SYSTEM.ADDRESS, while the sibling module contains the forwarding definitions to the lower-level allocator.
